Hello, Artist!

I absolutely love your art style! This time, I’d like to request an illustration of two of my original characters (who are in a romantic relationship). They are master and servant, partners, and lovers.  

  🦋 Character 1: April [Top/184cm/19 years old]
He has a cheerful, gentlemanly, and friendly personality. As Silver’s right-hand man, he eliminates anyone who threatens his family. He has black hair styled to cover his left eye, with a single strand of white hair. Both of his eyes are green, and black butterfly wings grow from his head. He also has an emotional and sensitive side when interacting with Silver.

🐺Character 2: Silver [Uke/174cm/16 years old]
A mafia boss with the ability to transform into a black wolf. Due to painful experiences in his childhood, he is calm and reserved, but he is very tolerant of April’s actions. He has short black hair, low-saturation purple eyes, and black animal ears and a tail.

Relationship 

April (🦋) serves as Silver’s (🐺) consigliere and guardian, guiding and caring for him. April shows deep devotion to Silver, though her care includes elements of obsession and favoritism. On the other hand, Silver, as the boss, maintains a cool exterior but places complete trust in April, tacitly condoning and willingly accepting all of his actions.

Feel free to change their outfits and designs as you like! If possible, I’d appreciate it if you could depict the difference in their builds (Silver is about half a head shorter than April and should look younger).

I will use this illustration for personal use (such as social media icons or phone wallpapers). Thank you so much for reading and considering this request. If this request is inappropriate, please feel free to cancel it.

If the payment amount is insufficient, please resend it…!  Thank you in advance!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ELhgR-asbNtVhyPQFjL1VpA7wg46wTGJ

To Mr. Savior,
I’ve always loved your art style, brushwork, and color palette, and I’ve been wanting to commission you for a long time!
I’d like you to draw my original character.
Here’s a brief description of her.

【Name】
Seina Sakasegawa

【Appearance】
She has ash-blonde hair and deep green eyes. Her hair is shoulder-to-chest length, worn in a semi-long style with her bangs down. She likes to have some of her hair flipped out at the ends. Her eyes are slightly slanted, and she has a distinctive beauty mark under her left eye. She is 156 cm tall, with a slender yet feminine figure and a healthy physique.

【Personality】
She has strong personal values and is the type who doesn’t get swayed by others, ultimately making her own decisions. While she usually keeps her distance and struggles to be completely open, she is very caring toward those close to her and tends to fuss over them, displaying a tsundere personality.


Please style her clothing with a Y2K vibe 🙇‍♂️
Nails, piercings, and accessories are up to you.
I also plan to use this for personal purposes, such as profile icons!
Thank you very much in advance.

救世主様

こんばんは、救世主様。
ツイッターからイラストを拝見させて頂いてファンになったものです。
女の子たちの目つき、顔立ち、それに太ももあたりの表現がすごく良かったです！
あ、女装の子もとてもきれいで可愛かったです！好き！
そんな救世主様がスケブを開いていらっしゃることを知り、もしよろしければこちらのオリキャラのことを依頼したいです。

お願い申し上げたいのはこちらのオリキャラ狐娘の万里香（まりか）という子です。
狐耳と尻尾・赤メガネ・アホ毛、そしてちょっぴりツリ目な目つきが特徴的な、160cmくらいの身長の高校生です。
本とか、動物や花、星空のような自然をぼーっと見るのが大好きな子です。
性格的には、ちょっと人見知りで照れ屋ですので人前では余計にクールっぷりしてるけどまた寂しがり屋のちょっと面倒くさい感じです。一人の時や知り合いの前では表情が緩めてちょっと豊かになる感じです。
これだけではちょっと説明が足りないと思いますので設定と設定画など、ご参考できそうなものを下のURLにまとめております。

この娘で救世主様の絵柄でのイラストをどうかお願いしたいです。
衣装は設定画のうちの一つで、本を持って、脚がきれいに見えるところがみたいです。他はご自由にお願いします！
ご検討くださいませ！

お忙しい中、要件のみで申し訳ありません。
応援しております！
